items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; considered week-to-week after exiting Week 4 early. Status for London game vs JAX expected Friday; trending toward missing or limited.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs with hamstring; Rapoport week-to-week context
items.implication: Major volume loss for Eagles run game; start/sit and handcuff urgency
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/routes to remaining RBs

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP Wednesday and Thursday after missing Week 4; trending toward missing Week 5 vs JAX.
items.implication: Further depletes Eagles pass catchers with Brown also out
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert/Wicks

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP Wednesday and Thursday; Friday practice key for Sunday night availability vs ATL. Chance he plays even without full practice per coach.
items.why: Ankle from Week 4; consecutive DNPs but coach open to play without practice
items.implication: Monitor closely; Huntley contingency if OUT
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup QB and pass-catcher shifts

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday (consecutive DNPs); availability in doubt vs DEN.
items.implication: Target share to other Chargers WRs if sits

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); coach says will miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Extended absence; Steelers WR depth impacted

items.text: With Barkley and Bigsby out, Adam Levitan and Evan Silva call for Will Shipley show vs Jacksonville; Shipley expected bulk of RB workload in London.
items.why: Only healthy RB on 53; dual-threat profile for pass downs
items.implication: Must-add/start candidate if available; high snap share expected
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, red-zone as lead back

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as his WR8; strong volume and red-zone in soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift vs Titans

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload and matchup, boosted by potential Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Volume + soft run D; WR absences increase checkdowns

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) for volume/matchup reasons.
Berry hates Jordan Addison (WR41 @ NO) and Mark Andrews (TE17 @ ATL); tough matchups/thin roles/injury wrinkle for Addison.
First Week 5 projections live; DET-ARZ shaping as one of most popular DFS stacks due to 54.5 total (no other >45.5) and pricing.
Levitan notes Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities YTD; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming.
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch; Bijan/Kyren trust, Jeanty/Brown caution
